# AI Usage 0.5.0.2
- Fix every provider showing "could not be reached" when the system proxy auto-config file is unreachable: requests now skip the system proxy.
This build is signed ad-hoc and not notarized. The first time you open the downloaded DMG, right-click the app and choose Open.

# AI Usage 0.5.0.1
First release of the mg-i-ant-mor fork, built on AI Usage 0.5.0. From this version on, updates come from this fork's feed, signed with the fork's own Sparkle key.
- Forecast when a limit runs out, using your working hours. - Track more than one Claude account, each identified by its keychain login. - Show a detailed tooltip, with limit icons colored by how much is used. - Show a daily budget until each long limit resets, and mark the on-pace point on each limit's bar.
This build is signed ad-hoc and not notarized. The first time you open the downloaded DMG, right-click the app and choose Open.
